san_andres_slider.W_form: W(K) = (log(K) + 2*(1 - K)/(1 + K))/(1 - K)**2, K = h_inlet/h_exit, w = 6*mu*U*L**2*B/h_exit**2 * W
san_andres_slider.mapping: K = 1 + alpha (book gap h = h0(1 + alpha x/L), pad moving +x: inlet h0(1+alpha) at x = L, exit h0)
san_andres_slider.source: https://rotorlab.tamu.edu/me626/Notes_pdf/Notes02_App_1D_bearings.pdf (PDF fetched 2026-09-28, text extracted with PyMuPDF, pp. 5-6 read)
san_andres_slider.digits: as printed (K_opt 5 significant figures; W, Pmax 3 figures; K_Pmax 4 figures)
san_andres_slider.label: V5

huppert_planar_current.pde: h_t - beta*(h**3*h_x)_x = 0, integral_0^{x_N} h dx = A (half-area)
huppert_planar_current.source: https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/maths/people/staff/tball/publications/similarity_preprint.pdf (PDF fetched 2026-09-28, text extracted with PyMuPDF, Appendix a, Eqs. A1-A7); citation of record H. E. Huppert, J. Fluid Mech. 121, 43-58 (1982)
huppert_planar_current.label: V5

oseen_drag.label: V1 form (coefficients 3/8, 9/40 are exact rationals of the theory)

stokes_law.pressure_form: p - p_inf = -3*mu*R*u/2*cos(theta)/r**2 (theta from the direction of the stream)
stokes_law.label: V1 form

taylor_couette.rayleigh: stable iff d(r*v)**2/dr >= 0 everywhere; for the Couette profile: mu_r > eta**2
taylor_couette.label: V1 form

morrison_sphere_drag.claim_tested: the correlation lies between Stokes 24/Re and Oseen (24/Re)(1 + 3Re/16) for 0.1 <= Re <= 5
morrison_sphere_drag.label: V5 (correlation, 3 % class)
